rule.name: ParallelStreamSharedMutation
rule.message: This lambda runs in a parallel stream and changes a plain collection or StringBuilder that was created outside it (add, put, merge, append and similar). A parallel stream runs the lambda on several threads at once, and ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet and StringBuilder are not thread safe, so elements are lost, the result is corrupted, or an exception is thrown, and only sometimes. Let the stream build the result: collect(Collectors.toList()), toList(), Collectors.toMap or Collectors.groupingBy, which merge the parts safely. An exception fits a concurrent collection, or a change made inside a synchronized block.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $spine := function($stage) { $stage/*[1]/descendant-or-self::MethodCall [empty(ancestor::ArgumentList intersect $stage/*[1]/descendant::ArgumentList)] }, $parallelChain := function($stage) { let $all := $spine($stage), $par := ($all[@MethodName = ('parallelStream', 'parallel')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0])[1], $chain := $all[. is $par or exists(descendant::MethodCall intersect $par)] return exists($par) and empty($chain[not(. is $par)][not(@MethodName = ('map', 'filter', 'peek', 'sorted', 'distinct', 'limit', 'skip', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'mapToObj', 'boxed', 'flatMap', 'unordered', 'takeWhile', 'dropWhile', 'parallel', 'asLongStream', 'asDoubleStream'))]) and empty($chain[@MethodName = 'sequential'][exists(descendant::MethodCall intersect $par)]) } return //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'map', 'filter', 'peek')][$parallelChain(.)] /ArgumentList/LambdaExpression//MethodCall [@MethodName = ('add', 'addAll', 'put', 'putAll', 'remove', 'append', 'push', 'offer', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'putIfAbsent')] [*[1]/self::VariableAccess] [let $n := *[1]/@Name, $lam := ancestor::LambdaExpression[1], $decls := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer][1] //VariableId[@Name = $n] | ancestor::ClassBody[1]/FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId[@Name = $n] return not($lam//VariableId[@Name = $n]) and exists($decls) and (every $d in $decls satisfies exists($d/parent::VariableDeclarator/ConstructorCall/ClassType [some $t in ('java.util.ArrayList', 'java.util.LinkedList', 'java.util.HashMap', 'java.util.LinkedHashMap', 'java.util.TreeMap', 'java.util.HashSet', 'java.util.LinkedHashSet', 'java.util.TreeSet', 'java.lang.StringBuilder', 'java.util.ArrayDeque') satisfies pmd-java:typeIsExactly($t)]))] [not(ancestor::SynchronizedStatement)]
